name: The Midnight Secrets
source:
A game about of four teenagers looking for excitement, and since it's Halloween, they wander through the dark streets... Suddenly, they see an antique shop that shouldn't be there.

[From [url=https://mhalia-loopy.itch.io/the-midnight-secrets]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一场关于四个青少年寻找刺激的游戏，由于是万圣节，他们在黑暗的街道上徘徊……突然，他们看到了一家不应该出现的古董店。

[来自[url=https://mhalia-loopy.itch.io/the-midnight-secrets]Itch.io[/url]]
